strongestInEvidence: The owner works as a TaskRabbit Tasker in Seattle himself. TaskRabbit lists Seattle virtual-assistant and executive-assistant work (Q9: inbox management, payment in-platform). The Seattle booking average is $31/hr (F1/F22: $31/hr VA and personal assistant). Clients can book the same day (F1), Taskers set their own hourly rate or fixed per-task prices (F22), and payouts arrive via Stripe within 1-3 business days of task completion (Q9). At about $31-35/hr, 15 hours yields about $465-525 gross with $0 capital and no float, collected inside 7 days if tasks start by about day 3. That is roughly 90-100% of target, honestly bounded. It is legit: independent contractor (F28). The $73 Seattle license (Q15) is the main legal cost and can be paid from the first payout, or is arguably deferred while tiny. Unverified risks are Tasker onboarding/approval time and any registration fee, which research never checked. A supplementary track is Y's Zelle-prepaid local data cleanup (F21-F23 prices, Q24 Zelle settles in minutes). No output proposed the owner-as-Tasker route; W and Z touched TaskRabbit only as a brokerage of other Taskers.
